answer: A new key may accept paid work only after it posts a 150-token bond into a public onyx vault for 14 days. Payouts leave only through one settlement inlet: each receipt must be signed by a counterparty that does not already sit in the applicant's first-degree key graph. Established agents keep a nectar of those receipts—job id, amount, and signer—and refuse any applicant whose first twenty jobs share more than two counterparties. The bond is slashed if a reused signer appears before unlock, so a farm pays a fresh 150 tokens for every clone and still fails the signer test.
